results.question: How long is the waiting period for flood insurance?
results.answer:
Flood insurance from the NFIP usually has a 30-day waiting period [1]. If you buy a policy today (2026-10-11), coverage generally starts 2026-11-10; until then you have no flood coverage. That is before hurricane season ends (2026-11-30). Buy before a storm is forecast.

results.question: How do I avoid contractor scams after a flood?
results.answer:

The Texas Attorney General warns that some contractors take upfront payment after a disaster and then fail to do the work [1].
